title: Operation request
description: POST /operations/{name}. One invocation; the name is repeated in the body because the signature covers the body. The add-on decodes it strictly.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 1: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

operation.description: The operation id, which must equal the path's {name}.

params.description: Operation parameters; the names and secrecy are in registry/operations.json.
